The network originated from in-depth research on monitoring changes in rice pest outbreaks in farmers' fields.

The research revealed an important truth: building a nationwide database of rice pest outbreaks requires more than one organization.

> **"A single government agency alone may not be enough"**
> both in terms of data continuity and the sheer scale of area coverage involved.

---

## Why Do We Need This Network?

Rice pest outbreaks occur constantly and change rapidly.
TRPMN has therefore invented and developed technology that serves as a **"central hub for data collection"**
and a **"voice for early-warning alerts."**

It emphasizes the participation of network members, whether local farmers
or officials from various sectors, who work together to share real-time information from the fields.

---

## Reliability Is at the Core

To ensure that the information gathered from the fields is accurate and practically usable,
TRPMN has built collaborations with **"academics and experts"**
who have specialized knowledge in analyzing rice pest outbreak reports.

This is to verify and confirm accuracy before relaying knowledge and alerts back to network members.

---

## Our Main Objectives

| Objective | Details |
|---|---|
| 🔗 Serve as a connecting hub | Build a network of collaboration among farmers, officials, and academics |
| 🗄️ Build a sustainable database | Continuously collect nationwide outbreak data using modern technology |
| 📢 Alert on rice pest outbreaks | Serve as the main channel for spreading outbreak news, so members can prepare in time |
| ✅ Improve accuracy | Have data vetted by experts, so every report leads to targeted solutions |

---

> **TRPMN is therefore not just a computer system**
> but a network of "people" working together to sustainably care for and protect Thailand's rice production."
